feeds.title: Gather Events Blog » European Wedding
feeds.description: Take a gander at what Gather Events have been up to. Check out our posts on European Weddings. Gather Events was built on a love of bringing people together. We are incredibly proud to be a team of highly experienced wedding planners and event designers who thrive on creating the most memorable weddings and social events locally and around the world.

feeds.title: Open the Door Events Blog
feeds.description: Designers of cozy magical destination weddings in Europe and Bali. Our events are sustainable, ethical and eclectic and our mission is to give back to planet earth by supporting small businesses and local communities and donating to land restoration. 'Open the Door Events' is a creative event design company that brings the dreamiest eco conscious weddings to life.

feeds.title: Style Me Pretty
feeds.description: Style Me Pretty is a place where Europe Weddings thrive and wedding style reigns queen. Our Europe Blog features real weddings from uber talented vendors. We are a husband and wife wedding photography team. Based in Los Angeles and traveling the world photographing beautiful things.

feeds.title: Weddings Abroad Blog
feeds.description: The comprehensive Weddings Abroad blog is packed with all the information you need to help you choose the perfect location and providers for your perfect day. Weddings Abroad, have been arranging unique, exciting destination weddings and vow renewal ceremonies all over the world since 1999.

feeds.title: Story Of Your Day Blog
feeds.description: The blog featured the latest wedding films from acclaimed wedding videography company Story Of Your Day from international destinations. Story Of Your Day is an international award-winning wedding film company. Creative Director Emma Wilson is an audiovisual storyteller & one of Europe's leading female wedding filmmakers.

feeds.title: Love My Dress Blog
feeds.description: Love My Dress is beautiful wedding blog full of inspiration for brides and those planning a wedding that embraces glamour and elegance and encourages sophistication and style, whilst remaining true to the love story behind every wedding. Love My Dress is a soulful platform for weddings, founded by Annabel Beeforth.

feeds.title: Molly Carr Photography » Wedding
feeds.description: Read the stories of luminous occasions, destination wedding planning tips, and snapshots from my international adventures. I am Molly Carr, a fine art destination wedding photographer eternally devoted to capturing the beauty of your union.

feeds.title: Aneta's European Floral Blog
feeds.description: Get the best advice for your wedding flowers with the European Floral blog. Aneta's European Floral is one of the best floral decoration for a wedding reception, engagement ceremonies, and birthday parties, etc. We provide the best wedding planning florist services in Woodbury passionately work to bring out the best results while keeping it in your budgets.

feeds.title: Destination Wedding Directory » Europe Wedding Guide
feeds.description: Everything you need to plan your dream destination wedding, including great tips, detailed country guides and a comprehensive wedding supplier directory. Destination Wedding Directory is connecting couples with the right destination and vendors. All you need to plan your dream destination in one place.

feeds.title: Jeanette Merstrand Photography Blog
feeds.description: I'm Jeanette, a photographer, a multicultural millennial, and a perfectionist trying to learn the joy of embracing average, while still dreaming big! On my blog I share all of my latest photoshoots, as well as my thoughts and musings on life and all of the ups and downs that that entails! Grab a cup of tea, a fluffy blanket, and cozy up with some of my blog posts!

feeds.title: Dina Deykun
feeds.description: Travel, weddings, engagements and photography are my passion - and I absolutely love to be able to share my experiences and tips. I'm Dina, Europe based photographer, experienced traveler, and wine enthusiast. I'm an artist who creates beautiful and romantic portraiture, and I'm committed to my art and every client's individuality.

feeds.title: Dream Weddings Europe Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Dream Weddings Europe's blog. Here you'll find many useful information about destination weddings in Europe, especially in Portugal and France. Dream Weddings Europe was founded in 2012 in Portugal, Lisbon and is led by its founder and CEO, Anastasiia Halla. Our primary focus is to imagine and create beautiful, meaningful and unforgettable Destination Weddings.

feeds.title: Lauren Fair Photography Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Lauren Fair Photography Blog, where they share recent weddings & sessions, our travels, and bits of our life. Hello! Lauren Fair, specializes in iconic, exquisite, joy-filled weddings. My photography focuses on stylish images full of beautiful light and natural emotion. With dreamy film tones and a relaxed approach, they capture wonderful clients' wedding days.

feeds.title: Veneer Designs
feeds.description: Visit the Devotion Dresses blog for the exquisite and unique bridal gowns and dresses. Devotiondresses.com is the one and only website offering truly individually tailor-made premium European wedding dresses handmade exclusively in Europe.

feeds.title: Devotion Blog
feeds.description: Dive into the journey of our event planning agency crafting exclusive destination weddings, elopements, marriage proposals, photo shoots, vow renewals, birthday parties at the finest venues in Europe. In our journal, we share full stories of real events and styled shoots we planned and designed, venue recommendations, behind the scenes and wedding tips.

feeds.title: Wedinspire » Destination Wedding
feeds.description: Wedding planning guides and inspiring ideas for getting married abroad, from vital planning checklists to specific destination legalities and collections of the most incredible venues overseas. The Wedinspire platform is specifically designed to connect modern couples with their dream wedding venue, in an inspirational, exciting and dare I say romantic way!
